_about: Third-party data inside LightSim's example projects and component catalogue.
docs/data-register.csv lists every dataset with its source and licence; the
sources whose licence asks for credit or a NOTICE are listed here, and
app's Help > Third-Party Notices) and in the SBOM. 'register' names the rows
of docs/data-register.csv that use the source; backend/tests/test_data_register.py
fails when a shipped row that needs credit is not listed here. 'notice' is the
source's NOTICE text, reproduced as its licence requires.

data.name: FASTSim vehicle and drive-cycle data
used: Values from FASTSim (NREL, now the National Laboratory of the Rockies), taken
from the fastsim 2.1.5 package and converted to LightSim's parameters and
units; no FASTSim file is included. The Battery Electric Car example's vehicle
values come from its 2021_Cupra_Born.csv and its motor loss map is calibrated
to its default motor efficiency curve; the drive cycles WLTC class 3b, UDDS
and HWFET in LightSim's drive-cycle library, which both examples use, come
from its cycle files; and the P2 Hybrid Car's auxiliary load, transmission
efficiency and wheel inertia follow its vehicle database.

data.name: Project Chrono tyre data
used: The tyre load-index table and the four coefficients of the TMeasy passenger-car
parameter guess (GuessPassCar70Par, after Rill's 'engineer's guess'), taken from
tyres.json, which fills a Wheel's radius and tyre estimates from its size code.
